tagline: A home of faith, a family of love, a beacon of hope and healing.
feastBanner: Upcoming Feast: Our Lady of Good Health Annual Feast on August 29th! Join us for the flag hoisting.

list.name: Anthoniyarpuram
list.desc: Known for its historic shrine and vibrant traditional choral ministry. The community gathers weekly for solemn novenas and coordinates the historic annual chariot procession that draws pilgrims from across the region.

list.name: Usillankadu
list.desc: A beautiful, serene community nestled near nature. Usillankadu boasts an active family prayer circle network (Anbiyam) and a newly renovated grotto dedicated to comforting the sick and homebound.

list.name: Pathakadu
list.desc: A dedicated labor-community hub with a deep commitment to social outreach. Pathakadu organizes the parish's seasonal agricultural blessing festivals and hosts the combined evening educational study circles for children.
